    for i in range(h):
        row=grid[i]
        for c in set(row):
            if c==0: continue
            cols=[j for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==c]
            for j in range(min(cols),max(cols)+1):
                out[i][j]=c
    vcols={}
    for j in range(w):
        vc=[(i,grid[i][j]) for i in range(h) if grid[i][j]!=0 and grid[i].count(grid[i][j])==1]
        if vc: vcols[j]=vc[-1][1]
    for j,v in vcols.items():
        cur=v
        for i in range(h-1,-1,-1):
            c=out[i][j]
            if c!=0 and out[i].count(c)>=2:
                cur=c
            out[i][j]=cur
    return out
'''
